# GlobalLink

Track your shipments, generate reports, and much more.

1. [Home Mohawk Global](https://mohawkglobal.com/)
2. >
3. [GlobalLink](https://mohawkglobal.com/globallink/)

#### The visibility you need, at your fingertips.

Redesigned and simplified for the ultimate ease of use, GlobalLink International has all the detail you need to track your shipments and review customs entries. **Sign up today to take advantage of these features:**

- Tracking from PO to POD
- View shipment details, including part and PO numbers
- Review Customs entries and flag problem entries
- Comment feature allows you to leave notes for our import staff on specific entries
- PARS/PAPS Tracking

[International Login](https://globallink.mohawkglobal.com/)
